headline: South Africa Business Council Engages US Over Bilateral Ties at B20
summary: Business Unity South Africa emphasised that South Africa and the United States need mutually beneficial economic relations during bilateral discussions at the B20 summit.
why: US trade relationships, including preferential access under AGOA, remain vital for South African manufacturing, automotive, and agricultural exports.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Constructive private-sector diplomacy supports the preservation of bilateral trade frameworks.
